initiatives.name: Board Governance Evolution
initiatives.summary: Stefan Bomhard will retire from the Board at the conclusion of the 2026 AGM after nine years at Compass, having stepped down from several committees in September 2025 ahead of his departure.

evidence.title: Board retirement of Stefan Bomhard
evidence.summary: Stefan Bomhard will retire from the Board at the conclusion of the 2026 AGM after nine years at Compass, having stepped down from several committees in September 2025 ahead of his departure.
evidence.quote: At the conclusion of the 2026 AGM, we will say farewell to Stefan Bomhard, who will retire after nine years at Compass. In advance of his retirement, Stefan stepped down from the Audit, Corporate Responsibility, Nomination and Remuneration Committees on 30 September 2025.

evidence.title: Governance simplification of Board committee operations
evidence.summary: The Board undertook a simplification exercise of its governance structure, making changes to directors' roles and responsibilities and reviewing the operation of principal committees to improve effectiveness, partly in response to the 2024 UK Corporate Governance Code.
evidence.quote: This year, the main governance focus of the Board and its committees has been on simplifying their operation, the introduction of the 2024 UK Corporate Governance Code, and the external Board performance review. As part of our simplification exercise, we made a number of changes to directors' roles and responsibilities and also reviewed the operation of the principal committees with a view to further improving their effectiveness.

evidence.title: Arlene Isaacs-Lowe named Corporate Responsibility Committee Chair
evidence.summary: Arlene Isaacs-Lowe succeeded Nelson Silva as Chair of the Corporate Responsibility Committee in February 2025, representing a governance leadership transition.
evidence.quote: Arlene Isaacs-Lowe succeeded Nelson Silva as Chair of the Corporate Responsibility Committee (the Committee) in February 2025.

evidence.title: New directors Liat Ben-Zur and Juliana Chugg completed induction
evidence.summary: Liat Ben-Zur and Juliana Chugg, both appointed to the Board in 2024, completed their induction programmes during the year, bringing new insights and experience to the Board and its committees.
evidence.quote: During the year, Liat Ben-Zur and Juliana Chugg, who were both appointed in 2024, completed their induction programmes and, together with their longer serving colleagues, they continue to bring valuable insights and experience to the Board and its committees.

initiatives.name: Debt Refinancing - €700 Million Bond
initiatives.summary: Compass issued a €700 million ($813 million) fixed-rate bond maturing in June 2032 to pre-finance maturing Eurobond and USPP notes, supporting liquidity management and refinancing strategy.

evidence.title: €700 million bond issuance to refinance debt
evidence.summary: Compass issued a €700 million ($813 million) fixed-rate bond maturing in June 2032 to pre-finance maturing Eurobond and USPP notes, supporting liquidity management and refinancing strategy.
evidence.quote: In June 2025, the Group issued a €700 million ($813 million) fixed-rate bond maturing in June 2032. The new bond effectively pre-financed a £250 million ($337 million) Eurobond and $300 million USPP note which matured and were repaid in September 2025.

initiatives.name: UK Pension Plan Buy-In Protection
initiatives.summary: In December 2024, the UK Pension Plan entered into a buy-in arrangement covering c.98% of its liabilities ($1.8 billion), protecting the Group's balance sheet from future volatility in financial markets and longevity rates.

evidence.title: UK Pension Plan buy-in protecting balance sheet
evidence.summary: In December 2024, the UK Pension Plan entered into a buy-in arrangement covering c.98% of its liabilities ($1.8 billion), protecting the Group's balance sheet from future volatility in financial markets and longevity rates.
evidence.quote: In December 2024, the UK Plan entered into a buy-in whereby c.98% of its liabilities of $1.8 billion at 30 September 2025 are covered by an insurance arrangement which protects the Group's balance sheet from future volatility in financial markets and longevity rates in respect of these liabilities.

initiatives.name: Climate Net Zero Commitment 2050
initiatives.summary: Compass has committed to achieving climate net zero by 2050 across its global operations and value chain, underpinned by approved science-based targets to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 46% and Scope 3 emissions from purchased food and drinks by 28% by 2030, versus a 2019 baseline.

evidence.title: Net zero by 2050 with science-based 2030 interim targets
evidence.summary: Compass has committed to achieving climate net zero by 2050 across its global operations and value chain, underpinned by approved science-based targets to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 46% and Scope 3 emissions from purchased food and drinks by 28% by 2030, versus a 2019 baseline.
evidence.quote: Our global target to reach climate net zero by 2050 is underpinned by approved science-based targets to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 46%, and absolute Scope 3 emissions from purchased food and drinks by 28% by 2030 (vs. a 2019 baseline1).

initiatives.name: Solutions Function - Digital, Data and AI Reorganization

evidence.title: Creation of new Solutions function integrating Digital, Data and AI
evidence.summary: Compass evolved its organizational structure to create a distinct Solutions function, separate from infrastructure services and cyber security, integrating Digital, Data and AI teams to accelerate value delivery and support net new business growth ambitions.
evidence.quote: The Board received an update from the Chief Solutions Officer on the evolution of the organisational structure to create a Solutions function, distinct from infrastructure services and cyber security. She also presented the revised Solutions framework, which had evolved to integrate the Digital, Data and AI teams in order to accelerate value delivery and help support Compass' net new growth ambition.
